summary: BTBT is a dual-catalyst moonshot: ETH treasury play (holds ETH + staking) AND AI/HPC infrastructure via WhiteFiber subsidiary. Strong Buy from HC Wainwright ($7 target = +222%), B. catalysts.name: WhiteFiber AI Data Center Ramp
catalysts.description: WhiteFiber (subsidiary, Nasdaq: WYFI) secured $100M delayed draw facility May 2026 for AI/HPC infrastructure expansion. Q2 results will show first full quarter of WhiteFiber contribution. Any large AI compute contract = major catalyst.

catalysts.name: ETH Price + Staking Yield
catalysts.description: BTBT holds ~25,000+ ETH ($60M+) plus staking yield. Any ETH price surge (ETF flows, Ethereum upgrade, BTC cycle spillover) directly lifts BTBT's balance sheet. $20M ETH purchased at ~$2,334 in May 2026.

catalysts.name: WhiteFiber Spin-off / Re-rating
catalysts.description: WhiteFiber trades separately (WYFI) but BTBT holds controlling interest. If WhiteFiber re-rates as a pure AI infrastructure play (like CoreWeave), BTBT's stake could be worth more than current market cap alone.

risks: ETH price is volatile — BTBT's balance sheet moves with ETH directly. ETH -50% = BTBT -60%+
B. Riley lowered target from $5 to $4 (May 2026) — AI data center ramp slower than expected
Q1 2026 net loss -$146.7M mainly from digital asset mark-to-market adjustments
WhiteFiber (WYFI) trades at discount to CoreWeave/pure AI infra peers — re-rating not guaranteed
349M shares outstanding = dilution pressure; equity raises possible to fund WhiteFiber expansion

estimateDates.note: First major AI compute contract announcement

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Crypto assets highly rate-sensitive. Fed cut = ETH price surge. Fed hold = range-bound. Rate hike signal = -30% ETH.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Bitcoin/ETH often used as inflation hedge, but correlation to risk assets in practice. Macro tightening hurts.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: AI data center demand secular — insulates WhiteFiber from rate cycle. But ETH treasury = rate-sensitive.
macroRisk.summary: Fed risk HIGH due to ETH exposure. WhiteFiber (AI infra) is Fed-neutral. If Fed cuts rates post-FOMC Jul 29 — BTBT could surge on both ETH rally AND AI risk-on. Worst case: rate hike signal + ETH sell-off.
